artworks.title: The Virgin and Child on the Crescent
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length figure of a person holding a baby in their arms. The person is positioned facing forward, gazing towards the baby, and dressed in a flowing robe and a helmet-like headpiece adorned with a radiating design. The facial features of the person appear solemn, with shadowed eyes and a sharp nose. The baby is nestled in the person's arms, with chubby features and a gaze directed towards the person holding it. Both figures are surrounded by a series of concentric circles that emanate outward, creating a halo effect around them. In the lower-left corner, the year '1520' is inscribed along with the initials 'ISP'. The background is a textured surface with lines radiating outward.

artworks.title: Study of a Man's Head with a Full Beard
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with red chalk and graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed artistic drawing of the head and upper torso of an older male figure in profile. The person faces left with his head slightly angled downwards, emphasizing his facial features. He has a prominent nose, deep-set eye sockets, wrinkles, a long beard, and long, graying hair. The man wears a simple garment, suggested by lines around his shoulders. The background is plain with some spots and blemishes.

artworks.title: Head of a Man, Full Face
artworks.medium: graphite and black chalk with brown wash, heightened with white, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays a close-up view of a man's head and partial upper body. The man has a full beard and moustache, and his facial features are detailed, with closed eyes. His hair is medium-length and slightly wavy, framing his face and extending to his ears. The man's clothing is in dark tones, blending with the textured, warm brown background. Light and shadow accentuate the contours of his face, giving the image a three-dimensional quality. No jewelry or additional objects are visible.

artworks.title: Clap of Thunder [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite  on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland scene with expressive brushstrokes depicting trees, figures, and foliage. The color palette is earthy with shades of brown and sepia. Two figures are visible near tall, twisting trees.

artworks.title: Crowd of People Seen between Two Columns [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black  chalk on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a crowded scene with multiple figures closely gathered together. The figures are depicted in swift, broad strokes suggesting movement and interaction. Varying shades of brown are used for depth and contrast. Two vertical lines are included in the composition, potentially representing pillars. The atmosphere is energetic and slightly somber, with a monochromatic color palette and fluid lines.

artworks.title: Head of a Man  (Possible Portrait of Professor E.D. Adams)
artworks.medium: black and red chalk with yellow-green crayon, heightened with white, over graphite on orange-pink prepared paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a portrait sketch of a man with a mustache and short hair, facing forward. His facial features include a prominent brow and defined lips, with a neutral expression and eyes looking straight ahead. The sketch showcases the texture of his facial hair and hair on his head. The background is plain peach, and the drawing fades out towards the neck. There are no visible clothing, accessories, or objects in the image. The sketch is signed "A. Legros" in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Mab and Cupid (Mab et Cupidon)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a seated baby and an adult facing each other. The baby is sitting upright with its head slightly turned to the viewer's right. The baby has curly hair and is depicted without clothing. The adult is reclining beside the baby, with long, wavy hair, wearing a head wrap or similar fabric. The adult's expression appears calm, with closed lips and eyes looking towards the baby. The scene is set against a textured background. In the lower left corner, the initials "A.L." are visible, and the artist's signature "A. Legros" is written below the scene.

artworks.title: Broken Cart (La charette brisee)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a seated person with a bearded face and a hood covering their head. They are wearing a long, draping garment and holding onto a cane or stick. Beside them is an overturned wooden wheelbarrow with a wheel. The background includes grass or vegetation, and the initials "A.L." are visible in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Auguste Rodin
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a detailed drawing of a man's head and neck in profile view. The man has an angular face with pronounced features, a long, full beard, short hair combed back, and a light and wispy texture. He appears to be dressed in a high-collared garment. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is a plain, light-colored surface with subtle texture, focusing on the man's facial profile.

artworks.title: Old man, Old Tree (Vieil homme, vieil arbre)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man seated on the ground with his head bowed and arms resting on his knees. He has a full beard and a balding head, wearing loose-fitting clothing and holding a stick. The background features a large, leafless tree with detailed bark and branches, creating a natural outdoor setting. Lines and shading convey texture and dimension throughout the image.

artworks.title: Unfurled Waves, Flood of September 1901 (Les lames deferlent,maree de Septembre 1901)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts an elevated view over the ocean, showing waves crashing onto the shore. The horizon is situated near the top, creating depth. Bold brushstrokes depict the movement and texture of the waves. The color palette includes blues, greys, whites, and sandy tones. Foam covers the beach in the foreground, while waves rise in the distance.

artworks.title: Herd of Sheep Near the Water
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with trees stretching upwards with leafless branches. More trees can be seen in the distance, creating depth. The scene is created using intricate etching with fine lines, resulting in a textured appearance. The color scheme is monochromatic, with black lines on a pale background, emphasizing the line work. The foreground features detailed and densely packed trees, while the background shows a softer, less defined area with grazing sheep. Sparse clouds can be seen in the sky.

artworks.title: Two Plank Hedges
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This image depicts a landscape with a rural scene. In the foreground, a small figure walks on a dirt path. The path is lined with trees on the right side. The horizon is at the lower quarter of the image, separating the land from the sky above. The drawing style resembles pen-and-ink with detailed linework and stippling for shading. The color scheme is black and white. The sky occupies the upper portion of the image.

artworks.title: Christ before Caiaphas
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures mostly in three-quarter view. A man with curly hair and a beard wearing a long robe appears to converse with another man seated to the right, who wears a lavishly decorated robe and a cap. The standing man is slightly hunched as he leans towards the seated man. Other figures surrounding them are dressed in armor, helmets, and holding medieval weapons. The composition suggests a gathering, possibly of a judicial or ceremonial nature. The armored men display serious expressions, with some having facial hair and decorated helmets. A large dog interacts playfully with a smaller animal. The background includes architectural elements like a high window, ornamental drapery, and garlands. The setting is rich in detail, creating a vivid representation of a historic or narrative moment.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image shows figures in armor and a central, partially clothed figure emerging from a tomb. The central figure stands confidently, raising one hand in a gesture, while carrying a staff with a banner in the other. Around this figure, several armored figures appear startled, with some having fallen to the ground in dramatic poses. The background features a rugged landscape with distant buildings atop hills, and a large tree stretches its branches over the scene. Above the scene, there are two shields with heraldic symbols.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a group of individuals surrounding a central figure in a tomb-like setting. The scene is highly detailed, showing ornate robes, facial expressions, and interactions between the figures. There is intricate foliage in the background, and a tree with a human-like trunk adds an otherworldly touch. The shading and cross-hatching techniques suggest attention to texture and depth. The style is reminiscent of Renaissance woodcuts and engravings, possibly influenced by artists like Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: The Gate in the Rocks
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed landscape scene with a variety of natural elements. The perspective is slightly elevated, showing intricate details in the foreground and a range of hills or mountains in the background. The horizon is low in the composition. The area features trees, houses, and other structures. Two tall, twisted trees with detailed bark and foliage are central. The etching technique is evident in the fine lines depicting branches and leaves. The color scheme is monochromatic, with various shades of gray creating depth through light and shadow. Clouds are delicately etched in the sky.

artworks.title: Christ Bearing the Cross
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic scene with various figures holding weapons. The artwork shows a dense assembly of figures carrying a large horizontal beam, many in medieval attire, helmets, and armor. In the foreground, a central figure is burdened by the beam, with their expression indicating distress. Shields or coat of arms adorn the wall in the background. The setting suggests a medieval environment, with an arched passageway visible and steps leading upward, where more figures are gathered. The drawing is detailed with intricate line work capturing the textures of the clothing, armor, and facial expressions of the individuals involved, depicting the tension and activity in the scene.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a group of figures on a platform and another group below them, expressing emotion. The image is detailed with figures and architecture, suggesting a narrative scene in a crowded setting. The figures on the platform appear engaged in a moment of interaction, while below, a group of figures in armor and robes look upwards, some making gestures. The surrounding architecture includes a brick wall and wooden structure. The shading and lines suggest a woodcut print style, portraying the scene's emotional gravity.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowd of figures in an indoor setting with two dogs in the foreground. The scene is densely packed with figures engaged in various interactions. Several figures are holding long staffs or poles. The setting is architectural, with a doorway surrounded by classical moldings and columns. Above the doorway, there are decorative elements resembling putti or cherubs. The drawing features intricate linework and cross-hatching for depth and detail.

artworks.title: Landscape, Evening
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays a scene with a person walking in a natural setting. The horizon is low in the image, nearly obscured by foliage. The brushstrokes are soft and fluid, creating dense trees and bushes. The color palette is dominated by sepia tones, emphasizing light and shadow, with a bright area of light coming from behind the trees.

artworks.title: Florestan Mionnet
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows an etched portrait of a seated man, displaying his torso up to his head. The man has distinct facial features, including a prominent nose, sharp eyebrows, and a full beard covering much of his lower face. He has dark hair styled with a center parting and swept back. The man is wearing a jacket with lapels and a shirt, depicted by fine etched lines. The background consists of textured vertical and horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Old man seated (Vieillard assis)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated person from the upper thighs to the head. The person has a bearded face with curly and slightly receding hair. They are wearing a buttoned jacket and have a somber expression. The individual's hands are resting on their knees as they face forward. The background is plain without any discernible objects or scenery, emphasizing the seated figure.

artworks.title: Frederic Regamey
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a three-quarter view, facing the viewer with a direct gaze. He has wavy hair, a beard, and a mustache, and is dressed in a collared shirt and a jacket with large buttons. The background is plain with hatching lines surrounding the figure.
